info.title: SwitchNest / RoboSphere API
info.description:
Smart-home IoT platform API — multi-tenant homes + devices + timers + shop.

**Auth:** saare endpoints `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>` (login se).
**ESP32/device endpoints** (`/api/device/*`): `?api_key=rs_...` query param ya `Authorization: Bearer rs_...`.
**Envelope:** har response `{ success, data }` ya `{ success:false, error:{ code, message } }`.
**Rate limits (per IP, 429 + Retry-After header):** login 10/15min · signup 5/15min · forgot-password 5/h · API-key create 20/h · support send 10/min · contact form 5/h · public assistant 20/min · claim 20/h · warranty status 30/min + claim 10/h · assistant chat message 20/min + confirm 30/min · ESP32 device API 1200/600 per min.

Raw spec: `GET /api/docs/openapi.json` · Offline list: `GET /api/docs/plain` · **ESP32 guide (curl/python/node + Arduino sketch): `GET /api/docs/esp32`**

post.summary: Account banao — user apne pehle Home ka owner ban jata hai (tokens + home auto-create).
Username ya email + password se login → access/refresh token pair.
Refresh token rotate karke naya token pair do (purana revoke).
Email pe password reset link bhejo (30 min valid). User enumeration se bachne ke liye unknown email pe bhi { sent:true }.
Reset token + naya password → password change, saare sessions logout.
Naya home banao (creator owner banta hai).
Ownership transfer kisi member ko (sirf owner).
Invite bhejo (email + role) → invite code generate (admin+).
